'''Dead Town''' was the informal name for one of the districts of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], located in the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|Undercity]]. It contained a number of mausolea in which numerous [[Death/Legends|dead]] Nar Shaddaans were interred. The mausolea were run by droids and occasionally raided by grave robbers.<ref name="LoNH" />
